newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Intel estimates hiked.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Intel estimates hiked.

text.p: -- Robertson, Stephens & Co raised its earnings estimates on Intel Corp to $1.32 a share from $1.24 for the third quarter, and to $1.55 from $1.35 for the fourth quarter.
-- Robertson also hiked its 1997 estimate to $6.60 a share from $6.00.
-- Analyst Dan Niles said he sees a lot of similarities between now and 1992's fourth quarter, the last time Intel preannounced positive earnings expectations.

-- In 1992, like now, Intel was transitioning its products in the market and memory prices were cheap, making PCs cheap and attractive to consumers, he said. Sales in the 1992 Q4 grew 30 pct, and EPS rose to $0.49 from $0.28 a year earlier.
